name: Völva (Rage Prophet)
body:
Some barbarian chiefs/shamans are able to contact the spirits of ancestors, interpret their will and, sometimes, let those spirits possess their bodies.

Requirements

To qualify to become a völva (male form: seidhmadhr), a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Special: Either phantom or spirit bonus class feature, moment of clarity rage power.
Feats: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Spellcasting Able to cast 1st-level occult spells.

This alters requirements.

Spellcasting

At the indicated levels, a völva gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in an occult spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one occult spellcasting class before becoming a völva, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

This alters spells per day.

Voice of the Ancestors

A völva’s class level stacks with barbarian levels for determining the effect of her rage powers (she does not gain additional rage powers) and with her medium or spiritualist level for the purpose of her phantom or spirit ability (not spirit bonus or spirit surge).

This replaces savage seer.

Ancestral Feats

At 2nd level and every 3 levels thereafter, a völva can select one of the following feats as a bonus feat: Combat Casting, Ecstatic Fury (see Feats below), Emotional Conduit, Empath, Extra Rage, Intuitive Spell, Logical Spell, Psychic Combatant, Psychic Defender, Psychic Healing, Psychic Maestro, Psychic Virtuoso, Raging Concentration, Spell Penetration, or Spirit Focus.

This replaces rage prophet mystery.

Raging Magic (Su)

At 2nd level, a völva is able to cast cure spells, spells granted by a spirit, or spells granted by the Emotional Conduit feat on herself while raging, without having to use clarity of mind or the Logical Spell feat.

This replaces raging healer.
